rows.label: tlk45320159_04_msg0001
rows.name:
I think the steam rifle is the finest
piece of equipment in the Superbian
Empire.

rows.label: tlk45320159_04_msg0002
rows.name:
Apparently they were inspired by, and
to an extent based upon, certain
long-range weapons used by Blades.

rows.label: tlk45320159_04_msg0003
rows.name:
With one of these, almost anyone can
fight reasonably well, even without
being a Driver.

rows.label: tlk45320159_04_msg0004
rows.name:
The ability to attack from a distance
is helpful, too. It helps us avoid
getting too close to monsters.
